findings.message: Acceptance criterion 1 requires tests/unit/test_loop_helpers.py to check that `serve_rig.until` and `serve_rig.turn` still resolve (`serve_rig.turn is tests.fakes.turn`). None of the added tests (test_serve_exports through test_serve_enable_upgrade) imports tests.integration.serve_rig or asserts on `until` or `turn`, so that part of the criterion is unmet. The hub could lose either attribute after this move and this test file would still pass.
findings.paved_road: Append a test to tests/unit/test_loop_helpers.py that runs `from tests.integration import serve_rig`, asserts `serve_rig.turn is fakes.turn` and `callable(serve_rig.until)`, and also asserts that each moved name on the hub (for example `serve_rig.graph is loop_helpers.graph`) is the shared object.
